title: Network Participation Agreements — Schedule of Agreement Types, Member Products Served and Payment Basis
content:
Cascade Mutual Dental & Vision admits dental and vision practices to its networks under six **Network Participation Agreements**. Each agreement type fixes which members the practice treats in network, how the practice is paid for covered services, who pays it, and whether the practice may bill a member beyond the member's share.

The six agreement types are the Cascade Savings Network Participating Provider Agreement, the Cascade Vision Network Provider Agreement, the Cascade DHMO Specialist Agreement, the Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement, the Cascade Premier Participating Dentist Agreement and the Cascade PPO Participating Dentist Agreement.

## Schedule

| Term | Savings Network | Vision Network | DHMO Specialist | DHMO Primary Care Dentist | Premier Participating Dentist | PPO Participating Dentist |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Member products treated in network | Savings memberships | Vision plans | DHMO specialty referrals | DHMO plans | Dental PPO Premier Access plans and orthodontic riders | Dental PPO plans and orthodontic riders |
| How the practice is paid | Member pays the discount schedule | Vision fee schedule | DHMO specialist fee schedule | Capitation plus member copay | Premier fee schedule | PPO fee schedule |
| Who pays the practice for covered services | The member pays the discounted fee | Cascade | Cascade | Cascade capitation plus the member copay | Cascade | Cascade |
| Capitation per assigned DHMO member per month (USD) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 11.85 | 0 | 0 |
| Day of the month capitation for that month is paid | 0 | 0 | 0 | 15 | 0 | 0 |
| Hold harmless (no balance billing) | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Reading the schedule

- **Capitation.** Capitation is a fixed amount in USD per assigned DHMO member per month paid to a primary care dentist. Only the Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement is capitated, at 11.85 USD per assigned member per month, paid on the 15th day of the month for that month. A value of 0.00 per member and payment day 0 mean the agreement is not capitated.
- **Hold harmless.** Where hold harmless applies, the practice may not bill the member more than the member's share of the agreement fee, so no balance billing is allowed. The Cascade Savings Network Participating Provider Agreement does not carry this term, because under it the member pays the practice the discounted fee directly.
- **Payment party.** Under every agreement except the savings network agreement, Cascade pays the practice for covered services; under the DHMO primary care dentist agreement Cascade's payment is the capitation, and the member pays the copay.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A hypothetical DHMO primary care dentist with 400 assigned members in a month is paid 400 times 11.85 USD, that is 4740.00 USD, on the 15th day of that month. A hypothetical optometrist under the Cascade Vision Network Provider Agreement receives no capitation; Cascade pays covered vision claims at the vision fee schedule, and the optometrist may not balance-bill the member.
